story: Food hero 19 s, ABCD. Why: a late-night craving, made irresistible. One hero motion per shot: 1 sizzle (hook) 2 cheese melt 3 bun pressed down 4 cut in half, steam 5 cheese pull 6 hero push-in. Add sizzle SFX, music and logo in the edit.
storyboard_prompts: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Food commercial, 9:16 vertical frame, macro to close-up, 100mm lens, shallow depth of field, slow motion. Warm tungsten key light from the back left, rim light catching steam and fat, the right side in deep warm shadow, a dark scorched wooden board and a cast-iron grill. The same burger in every shot; no new ingredients appear, nothing changes shape on its own. Panel 1 (top left): HOOK: macro of the thick beef patty on a black cast-iron grill, fat spitting and sizzling, smoke curling up, a dark crust forming. Panel 2 (top right): MELT: a square slice of yellow cheddar on top of the patty on the grill, the corners softening and sliding down the sides, glossy. Panel 3 (bottom left): ASSEMBLE: a hand presses the sesame top bun down onto a classic cheeseburger: a soft golden sesame-seed bun, a thick dark-seared beef patty, one square slice of yellow cheddar melting over the patty, and frilly green lettuce under the patty on the dark board, juice beading at the edge. Panel 4 (bottom right): CUT: the cheeseburger cut cleanly in half on the board, steam rising from the pink-brown cross-section, melted cheese and lettuce layers visible. The same light, board and grill in every panel. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real crumbs, dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
